data.name: Rogue Talents
data.description: The following rogue talents complement the eldritch raider archetype: major magic, minor magic, quick disable, trap spotter (Core Rulebook); fast picks (Advanced Player's Guide); black market connections, esoteric scholar, ninja trick (slow metabolism, wall climber) (Ultimate Combat).
